faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Cocker Spaniel?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 20-30 lb (9-14 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Cocker Spaniel?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Ear infections; Eye issues (cataracts/glaucoma risk); Hip dysplasia. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Cocker Spaniel at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Cocker Spaniel default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
